App and browser icons

Square white app tile: 16, 32, 48, 64, 128, 180, 192, 256, 512 and 1024px. Includes a multiresolution ICO, SVG favicon, Apple touch icon and PWA manifest. Allow the platform to apply its corner mask. The full mark is retained; tiny favicons naturally show less detail.

Keep the identity consistent

Retain aspect ratio. Do not stretch, rotate, substitute fonts or add effects. Leave clear space: 10% of logo height for full, stacked and wordmark; 25% of height for horizontal; 10% of width for the standalone mark. Use the full lockup only where the tagline is readable.

Sapphire #21407A remains the UI primary from the supplied branding. Gradient blue and cyan belong to the logo palette. Verify contrast for your actual UI colour combinations.

These are RGB assets. For colour-critical commercial printing, request a printer-approved CMYK proof. For web use, see the manifest, colour tokens and integration snippet in 05-Web.
